policies.title: Shared accommodation
policies.description: Apartment rent, lodging, household utility bills and overnight room costs shared by all housemates.

policies.title: Dining pair
policies.description: Meals, restaurants, groceries, breakfast food and refreshments for Avery and Blair only.
